title: Split merge dynamics for expanding intervals and point processes on the real line
summary: We study sequences of partitions of a non decreasing sequence I n of intervals into subintervals, starting from the trivial partition, in which each partition is obtained from the one before by splitting its subintervals in two, according to a given rule, and then merging pairs of subintervals at the break points of the old partition. The nth partition then comprises n+1 subintervals with n break points.
